text:
zoe: Alert - canary eu-west failing mount errors after deploy, pods CrashLoopBackOff  (Err: PVC not found)
deploy-bot: [automated] Canary failure mydb-service v1.9.0-canary (eu-west). Event: PersistentVolumeClaim "data-mydb-prod" not found. Merged overlays: base,region-eu,db-scaling,staging-pvcname
mike: staging-pvcname? That overlay renames PVCs for ephemeral dev clusters. How did that merge into prod?
zoe: Looks like the overlay-merge picked up a staging overlay with pvc.name: data-mydb-prod-dev -> that changed the claim name in rendered template.
ops-oncall: Remediation options: A) rollback helm release to 1.8.4 (fast) B) values-hotfix to restore pvc.name to data-mydb-prod and redeploy (preserves chart fixes). Change window open ~40m.
tara: Prefer hotfix values-only to avoid reverting DB-related chart fixes. I'll prepare hotfix-values to set pvc.name explicitly to data-mydb-prod and promote. Also request deploy-bot pin for eu-west.
zoe: Runbook snippet:
```bash
helm upgrade --install mydb ./charts/mydb -f values.yaml -f hotfix-pvc.values.yaml --namespace prod-eu-west
kubectl rollout status sts/mydb -n prod-eu-west --timeout=180s
```
mike: Also add a preflight to overlay-merge to reject overlays with names containing "staging" when target=prod and to forbid pvc.name keys in prod overlays unless explicitly allowed. I'll open PR #4987.
deploy-bot: Manual pin requested by @tara: pin mydb chart to 1.8.4 for eu-west until validation completes. Automated rollback skipped.
tara: Hotfix applied -> release 1.9.0-hotfix (values-only). StatefulSet recreated, PVC name restored, mounts healthy. Smoke tests 200.
ops-oncall: Monitoring for 20m. Keep pin and run data sanity checks.
zoe: After validation, unpin and add release-note: "hotfix(values): restore PVC name after staging overlay accidentally merged into prod; prevents data mount failure in eu-west canary".
mike: PR #4987 opened with overlay-name block and pvc-name schema rule + unit test.
tara: TL;DR: values hotfix fixed mounts, canary pinned, follow-ups: overlay preflight + release note + runbook update. :white_check_mark:
deploy-bot: Pin cleared by @ops-oncall after validation window. (automated)
